text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uhh... I felt like I was in some kinda
dream, and...
before I knew it, I was at
the finish line!
choice_data_list: おめでとう、いい走りだったぞ！
おめでとう、いい走りだったね！
choice_data_list_en: Congratulations, that was a great run!
Congratulations, that was a great run!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, thank you! I've really gotten
faster,
haven't I?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
choice_data_list: 次は、いよいよ『日本ダービー』だな
次は、いよいよ『日本ダービー』だね
choice_data_list_en: Next up is finally the Japan Derby.
The Japan Derby is finally next, huh?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If we keep working together, I'll get
faster and
faster. And then I'll win that
race—just you wait
and see!
